escena: SCENE (Efeonce office, Santiago, high floor, late morning): the production table corner of the Efeonce studio, from a stool at the big worktable, seen from the chair of someone sitting there on a video call — camera at SEATED EYE LEVEL (about 1.15 m), 28 mm lens at f/5.6, like a good webcam view, looking straight at a matte dark-navy painted wall 2.5 m away; horizon level, verticals straight. RIGHT THIRD: Image 2 is the final artwork of that wall — «Hecho a mano» in large white letters with its orange sphere as the period, and «(casi)» added by hand beside it — reproduce it exactly: the letters as matte white paint with crisp stencil edges, the «(casi)» as real white chalk-marker handwriting. In the foreground a large white solid-surface worktable on slim black steel legs carries real modelling-clay work: steel sculpting tools, a cutting mat, simple clay forms in off-white and cobalt blue (spheres, a half-shaped piece, a rolled coil) and a small hand-made clay orbit — a thin off-white clay ring lying flat with a small cobalt clay sphere resting on its rim; among the clay, a current-generation pen tablet shows a digital 3D sculpt of the same half-shaped piece on its glowing screen. At the bottom RIGHT corner of the table, the official Efeonce logo from Image 1 as a small solid WHITE desk object about 24 cm wide and 6 cm tall, standing upright between 75% and 96% of the frame width, turned towards the camera: product placement, reproduced exactly (every letter of «efeonce», the ship emblem with its orbit ring, its cuts and its three small windows), matte white finish, crisp bevel, like a finished piece among the work. LIGHT: hard low sun from the LEFT through the glazing crosses the haze as solid visible shafts and rakes across the table and the lettering; the centre of the navy wall stays calm in deep, detailed shade. TRACES OF WORK: a clay tool left mid-stroke on the half-shaped piece, a damp cloth folded on the table edge. MODERN FLOOR (2026, premium technology company): floor-to-ceiling glazing with slim black frames; smooth exposed concrete ceiling with recessed black linear LED profiles switched off; seamless pale microcement floor; furniture with clean lines — pale solid-surface or light-oak tables on slim black steel legs, graphite ergonomic mesh chairs, handle-less storage; current-generation technology only. At most ONE sculptural plant in the whole frame. Nothing vintage or rustic: no reclaimed wood, no brass, no Edison bulbs, no wooden brackets, no clutter. Nothing else on the walls: no posters, no clocks, no extra signage and no extra text anywhere. TEXT EXCEPTION: the logo from Image 1 and the artworks from Image 2 are the ONLY readable marks in the picture; they stay crisp and legible, every letter and word exactly as in the references, never blurred, altered or translated; every other screen, paper or label stays illegible by physical means.
